ops.title: fixes-pack scratch_writes auto-approver + evt.cwd shipped 2026-07-14 (CHANGELOG 9.15.0, unreleased); key design traps and accepted residuals
ops.body:
Fixes pack gained `scratch_writes` (commit e82b8da8, merged 2b320d3d to main 2026-07-14; CHANGELOG 9.15.0, tag NOT yet cut): auto-approves Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit targets resolving into /tmp, /private/tmp, /var/folders, /dev/shm or a tmp/temp/scratch/scratchpad(s)-named dir, gated on `SkipPermissions()` ONLY — user explicitly rejected `InPlanMode()` gating because a subagent's dialog payload reports the child's own permission_mode, missing the forwarded plan-mode case. `evt.cwd` is now a public BaseHookEvent property and `Input(cwd=...)` threads via ctx_kw through every mock builder.

**Why:** plan mode overrides bypass consent, so plan-phase subagent scratch writes popped dialogs (screenshot case: Write to `../../../../tmp/sweep_arc.py` from a forensics subagent).

**How to apply:** Design + accepted residuals live in cc-notes doc 94e5fed5 — read it before "fixing" the unreachable-but-deliberate `skip_if=[McpTool()]` (dependency-drift guard: mcp tools currently die at `evt.file is None`), the whole-subtree scratch-name matching (user's confirmed pick), or reintroducing `tempfile.gettempdir()` into TEMP_ROOTS (codex-confirmed daemon false-positive: a worker's frozen custom TMPDIR pins a writable dir as auto-approved). Relative paths without payload cwd fail closed. Live-verified via tmux (headless -p runs zero PermissionRequest hooks); ledger row = `fixes.scratch_writes:approve_scratch_dir_writes_under_skip_permissions`, event=PreToolUse action=allow. Related: [[cc-teammate-permissionrequest-forward-bypass]].
